cves.description: A vulnerability was determined in jeecgboot jeewx-boot up to 641ab52c3e1845fec39996d7794c33fb40dad1dd. This issue affects the function MyJwWebJwid3Controller.doUpload of the file jeewx-boot-module-weixin/src/main/java/com/jeecg/p3/open/web/back/MyJwWebJwid3Controller.java of the component doUpload Endpoint. Executing a manipulation of the argument File can lead to unrestricted upload. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. This product implements a rolling release for ongoing delivery, which means version information for affected or updated releases is unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：jeecgboot jeewx-boot
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性
